description: For CAD, use the execution-arm offline library and current FoundationPose, with 0 mm extra insertion by default. For an unknown object, send its current TSDF surface to GraspGen for 100 candidates per round. Convert the model contact frame to the actual Tianji gripper_front_A/B. The model base-to-contact offset is 195 mm and the robot mount-to-front offset is 185 mm. Retain tool +Z across the continuous forward-to-down pitch sector with at most 45 degrees lateral deviation, apply the configured local +Z insertion (default 10 mm, range 0–20 mm), select the equivalent jaw rotation, and verify the RAG pad support and opening. Over an observed bin floor, prefer top-entry candidates, then forward candidates. Within each approach group, try the narrower projected openings first. Numerical endpoint, collision and sampled FK checks cover the three-phase trajectory and the 150 mm world +Z lift. Remain bound to the arm, target, capture and scene. The graph may request a second round after confirmed exhaustion.
capability: For CAD use the execution-arm offline library with current FoundationPose and default extra insertion 0 mm; TSDF GraspGen poses use the actual arm front TCP with the configured local +Z insertion, applied once before IK
